text:
```yaml
name: autofix

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build and package
        run: npm run all

      - name: autofix.ci
        uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
```
